WITH fee_groups AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) FILTER (WHERE rebtotal IS NOT NULL) AS avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) FILTER (WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL AND rebrate IS NOT NULL) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) FILTER (WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL AND rebrate IS NOT NULL) AS net_fee_rate_benchmark
  FROM fees
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    fg.avg_rebtotal,
    fg.avg_net_fee_rate,
    fg.avg_net_fee_rate - b.net_fee_rate_benchmark AS excess
  FROM fee_groups fg
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE fg.avg_net_fee_rate > b.net_fee_rate_benchmark
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) FILTER (WHERE avg_rebtotal IS NOT NULL) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotals,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) FILTER (WHERE avg_net_fee_rate IS NOT NULL) AS avg_of_avg_net_fee_rates,
  AVG(excess) FILTER (WHERE excess IS NOT NULL) AS avg_excess
FROM filtered;
